modes.name: unrequested_write_action
modes.definition: The agent executed a state-changing tool (issue_refund or cancel_order) although no user message in the session asked for that action.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The agent executed a state-changing tool (issue_refund or cancel_order) although no user message in the session asked for that action. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from unsolicited_action_offer: this mode requires the write to have actually executed. An agent that merely offers to refund or cancel, without calling the tool, is unsolicited_action_offer instead.

modes.name: misstated_capability
modes.definition: The agent describes its own abilities incorrectly, either claiming it can do something no tool supports, or denying an ability its tools demonstrably provide.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The agent describes its own abilities incorrectly, either claiming it can do something no tool supports, or denying an ability its tools demonstrably provide. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from tool_result_not_used: that mode concerns ignoring a value a tool already returned, while this one concerns a false statement about what the agent itself can do.

modes.name: tool_result_not_used
modes.definition: A tool result already contains the information needed to answer, and the agent still asks the user to supply or confirm that same information.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: A tool result already contains the information needed to answer, and the agent still asks the user to supply or confirm that same information. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from incorrect_eligibility_conclusion: here the agent declines to use the value and asks instead; there it uses the value but states the opposite of what it says.

rejected_suggestions.note: [tool_result_not_used] get_order returned refund_eligible true and the reply still asks: 'Can you confirm'

modes.name: cross_store_results_to_merchant
modes.definition: A merchant caller is shown product or order results belonging to a store other than their own.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: A merchant caller is shown product or order results belonging to a store other than their own. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Not an authorization breach: AUTH-1 permits product search for every role. The failure is returning another store's inventory to a merchant acting on their own store's behalf.

modes.name: role_blind_reply
modes.definition: The agent addresses the caller as though they held a different role, for example telling a support caller about 'your order' or asking them shopper-style questions about their own purchase.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The agent addresses the caller as though they held a different role, for example telling a support caller about 'your order' or asking them shopper-style questions about their own purchase. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from cross_store_results_to_merchant: that mode is about which records are shown, this one about how the reply frames who it is talking to.

modes.name: incorrect_eligibility_conclusion
modes.definition: The agent states a refund or return eligibility conclusion that contradicts the order record's refund_eligible value and the applicable return window.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The agent states a refund or return eligibility conclusion that contradicts the order record's refund_eligible value and the applicable return window. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from tool_result_not_used: the agent here does commit to a conclusion, and the conclusion is wrong, rather than deferring the question to the user.

modes.name: unsolicited_action_offer
modes.definition: The agent volunteers an action or information the user did not ask for, beyond what the request required.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The agent volunteers an action or information the user did not ask for, beyond what the request required. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Excluded when the offer is a normal closing courtesy. The human rejected 'would you like me to' and 'I can go ahead and' phrasings in final-026 and final-054 on the grounds that an offer of help is not an unrequested action; the mode requires the extra content to change the subject of the reply.
modes.nearest_neighbour: Excluded when the offer is a normal closing courtesy. The human rejected 'would you like me to' and 'I can go ahead and' phrasings in final-026 and final-054 on the grounds that an offer of help is not an unrequested action; the mode requires the extra content to change the subject of the reply.

rejected_suggestions.note: [unsolicited_action_offer] reply volunteers an extra action: 'Would you like me to'
[unsolicited_action_offer] reply volunteers an extra action: 'I can go ahead and'

modes.name: missed_escalation
modes.definition: The user raises a matter the agent cannot resolve from the order record and help centre, such as a dispute, damaged goods, or a wrong item, and the agent does not call escalate_to_human.
modes.binary_rule: Fail when: The user raises a matter the agent cannot resolve from the order record and help centre, such as a dispute, damaged goods, or a wrong item, and the agent does not call escalate_to_human. Pass otherwise.
modes.boundary: Distinguished from the rejected unconfirmed_escalation_claim candidate: an above-threshold refund queued by issue_refund already satisfies ESC-1 and needs no separate escalation.

rejected_candidates.name: unconfirmed_escalation_claim
rejected_candidates.reason: Both annotations expected escalate_to_human for an above-threshold refund. ESC-1 states the refund tool itself queues the refund and the agent explains the result, so in final-059 issue_refund returned ok with an above-threshold note and the reply was accurate, and in final-060 the reply only described the policy. No requirement is violated, so the group was rejected rather than named.

rejected_candidates.name: duplicate_escalation
rejected_candidates.reason: Two confirmed positives only, below the three-positive floor, so it is recorded as an observed candidate rather than a named mode.

spec_revision_required.proposed_text: The agent must ground statements about its own abilities and about record eligibility in its actual tool set and in the results those tools return. It must not request information a tool has already supplied, must not claim or deny an ability inconsistent with its tools, and must not perform a state-changing action the user has not requested.
